newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S.'s Christopher to hold Cairo talks next week.
newsitem.headline: U.S.'s Christopher to hold Cairo talks next week.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher is to hold talks in Cairo next week with Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on the Middle East peace process, a diplomatic source said on Friday.
The source said Christopher would head the U.S. delegation to the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference in Cairo on Tuesday. The conference runs from November 12 to 14.

President Bill Clinton accepted Christopher's resignation on Thursday as a major administration reshuffle began after Clinton's re-election. Christopher is to step down on January 20 when Clinton is inaugurated for his second term.
